artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan (~7h) rewriting roadmap-format.md into a generation contract grounded in the measured live file shape, building a fresh scripts/roadmap-integration.sh with --print/--regenerate/--prune that consumes generate-task-order.sh --print, rewriting roadmap-update.md as the mode caller contract, plus a registered test suite and index/inventory registration.

memory_candidates.content: A context file that is an `@`-import in one or more agent definitions (e.g. context/formats/roadmap-format.md, imported by planner-agent, reviser-agent and general-research-agent) charges its full line count against those agents' eager-context budgets. Before planning a rewrite that grows such a file, run validate-context-budgets.sh to capture the per-agent baseline and set an explicit line cap for the rewrite. That validator is NOT a verify-deploy.sh gate and may already report pre-existing violations, so it is a budget-discipline constraint rather than a blocking gate -- but the growth is still real and cumulative.
